name: JustScreen
summary:
# Your movies. Your screen. Nothing else.

JustScreen is a private, local-first VR media player for Meta Quest. Browse your own movies and TV shows from compatible UPnP/DLNA servers, choose what to watch, make the screen exactly how you like it, and let the controls disappear.

## Make the screen yours

Go from TV-sized to huge and curved. Adjust **size, distance, height and curvature**, recenter instantly, and save your favorite screen profiles.
